subject: Applications open: Cloud Engineering Intern, Summer 2027
body:
Hi there,

Northwind Systems is now accepting applications for our Cloud Engineering Intern program for Summer 2027. Interns work on real infrastructure projects with AWS and Kubernetes.

Applications close on 2026-10-31. Apply early, we review on a rolling basis.

Best,
Northwind University Recruiting

Please pick a time slot using the scheduling link no later than 2026-10-10. Slots are first come, first served.

Good luck!
Contoso Cloud Talent Team
